description: The CPC Expansion Program is a school-based programme run by the Child-Parent Center model that provides continuous early education and family-support services from preschool through third grade for children in high-poverty communities.
title: CPC Expansion Program

description: A 12-item Likert-type questionnaire developed and validated by Bakwa Kanyinga Felly et al.
title: CPD-REACTION

description: CPLINTS is a 43-item observational assessment tool developed for rating circulating nurses' task management, teamwork, situational awareness, communication, and leadership in operating-room practice.
title: CPLINTS (Circulating Practitioners' List of Nontechnical Skills)

description: CPMP-Tools is mathematical software developed for the Core-Plus Mathematics Project to support graphing, problem solving, modeling, and inquiry-oriented mathematics instruction.
title: CPMP-Tools

description: A UK Data Service ReShare Repository dataset of multi-angle CPR performance videos, expert quality ratings, participant self-reports, and demographics, created by Constable et al.
title: CPR skills performance video database hosted at the UK Data Service ReShare Repository

description: CPR Team Leader is a tablet-based advanced-life-support algorithm cognitive-aid application made by Alphabet Medical GmbH for resuscitation team leaders and teams.
title: CPR Team Leader app

description: CPR Tutor is a C# multimodal CPR-training application developed by Di Mitri et al.
title: CPR Tutor

description: A Chicago Public Schools survey and composite reform index developed to measure elementary teachers' views of school governance, work conditions, school quality, instruction, and school reform in 1991.
title: CPS Elementary Teacher Survey and General Reform Index

description: A Consortium-reconstructed analytic file linking five back-end CPS Gradebook tables for 17,056 ninth-grade students, 366 teachers, 86 schools, and 1,804 algebra and geometry sections in 2016–17.
title: CPS Gradebook reconstructed 2016–17 analytic dataset

description: CPS Harvey is a moderate-fidelity patient-simulation system that reproduces cardiac and respiratory findings and blood-pressure conditions for clinical-skills training, used by medical educators.
title: CPS Harvey cardiopulmonary auscultation patient simulator
